Decision Matrix

Compare options against criteria when the next step is not obvious. Enter one option per line and one criterion per line. Add a weight with a colon, such as cost: 2.

This prototype ranks options locally using simple deterministic rules. It does not call live AI or external services inside the browser.

Inputs

Ranking

  1. Empty state: add options and criteria, then compare.
Recommendation will appear here.
Tradeoff notes will appear here.

const optionInput=document.getElementById('decision-options');const criteriaInput=document.getElementById('decision-criteria');const rankingNode=document.getElementById('decision-ranking');const recommendationNode=document.getElementById('decision-recommendation');const tradeoffsNode=document.getElementById('decision-tradeoffs');function cleanLines(value){return String(value||'').split(/\n+/).map(item=>item.trim()).filter(Boolean);}function parseCriteria(value){const criteria=cleanLines(value).map(item=>{const parts=item.split(':');const label=parts[0].trim();const weight=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(parts[1])||1));return {label,weight};}).filter(item=>item.label);return criteria;}function scoreOption(option,criteria,index){const text=option.toLowerCase();return criteria.reduce((total,criterion,criterionIndex)=>{const words=criterion.label.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);const matches=words.filter(word=>text.includes(word)).length;const lengthSignal=Math.min(4,Math.ceil(option.length/16));const positionSignal=(index+criterionIndex)%3;return total+criterion.weight*(matches*4+lengthSignal+positionSignal);},0);}function renderEmpty(message){rankingNode.innerHTML='
  • Empty state: '+message+'
    • ';recommendationNode.textContent='Add at least two options and one criterion before choosing a recommendation.';tradeoffsNode.textContent='Tradeoffs will appear when the comparison has enough input.';}function compareOptions(){const options=cleanLines(optionInput.value);const criteria=parseCriteria(criteriaInput.value);if(options.length<2){renderEmpty('enter at least two options, one per line.');return;}if(!criteria.length){renderEmpty('enter at least one criterion, such as cost, speed, confidence, or learning.');return;}const ranked=options.map((option,index)=>({option,score:scoreOption(option,criteria,index)})).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.option.localeCompare(b.option));const best=ranked[0];const second=ranked[1];rankingNode.innerHTML=ranked.map((item,index)=>'
  • #'+(index+1)+' '+item.option+' - local score '+item.score+'
    • ').join('');recommendationNode.textContent='Recommendation: choose '+best.option+' first because it ranks highest against '+criteria.map(item=>item.label).join(', ')+'.';tradeoffsNode.textContent=second?'Tradeoff notes: '+best.option+' leads '+second.option+' by '+(best.score-second.score)+' point(s). If the gap is small, test both options with one real constraint before committing.':'Tradeoff notes: add another option to see a real comparison.';}function clearDecision(){optionInput.value='';criteriaInput.value='';renderEmpty('add options and criteria, then compare.');optionInput.focus();}document.getElementById('compare-options').addEventListener('click',compareOptions);document.getElementById('clear-decision').addEventListener('click',clearDecision);renderEmpty('add options and criteria, then compare.');

# Decision Matrix

Decision Matrix is a local, browser-only prototype for comparing options against decision criteria.

## How to run
Run `python3 -m http.server 8080` in this folder, then open `index.html` from the local server.

## How to use it
Enter one option per line. Enter one criterion per line, optionally with a weight like `cost: 2`. Click **Compare Options** to see a ranked list, recommendation, and tradeoff notes.

## Limits
This prototype ranks options locally using simple deterministic rules. It does not call live AI or external services inside the browser. Scores are directional, not objective truth.

# Test Plan

- Open `index.html` in a browser.
- Confirm the visible note says: This prototype ranks options locally using simple deterministic rules. It does not call live AI or external services inside the browser.
- Enter at least three options and at least two criteria.
- Click **Compare Options** and confirm the ranked list updates.
- Confirm the recommendation names the top option and references the criteria.
- Confirm tradeoff notes compare the top options.
- Clear all fields and confirm the empty state returns.
- Disable network access and confirm the comparison still works.
